```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## 1. Load data

```{r}
sales_df <- read_csv("data/week1_sales.csv")
```

## 2. Inspect structure

```{r}
nrow(sales_df)
ncol(sales_df)
names(sales_df)
str(sales_df)
```

## 3. Grouped summary

```{r}
summary_tbl <- sales_df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_tbl
```
